title: Reading range boundaries and steps
description: You can compare upward, stepped and downward loops.

steps.description: range(1, 11) supplies 1 through 10. You keep each value on the same line with end set to a space, then print a newline.
The step of five produces 0, 5, 10 and 15. The stop value 20 lies outside the range.

steps.question: Which values does the negative step produce before reaching the stop boundary?
steps.answer: It produces 3, 2 and 1. The range stops before zero.

steps.description: You see 3 2 1 followed by the liftoff message on the same line. The last print runs after the downward loop.
